verdict.rationale: Scheduling recurring jobs is a fair question for an API platform, but nothing in the evidence shows OpenRouter offering scheduled, cron-style, or recurring workflow execution. Workspace budgets reset on daily, weekly, or monthly intervals, but that is a spend cap, not job scheduling. Agent-building and tool-calling features cover one-off requests, not recurring schedules.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
